query:
SELECT p.id, p.registrationId, p.name, p.birthDate, p.phone, p.affiliation,
       r.id as regId, r.tournamentEventId, r.userId, r.status, r.registrationNumber,
       te.eventType, te.skillLevel
FROM players p
JOIN registrations r ON r.id = p.registrationId
LEFT JOIN tournament_events te ON te.id = r.tournamentEventId
WHERE p.name LIKE '%임재호%' AND r.tournamentId = 1
ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC;
